questions.q: What is the main idea of LLMTime?
options: Write the series as text, digit by digit, and let a pre-trained LLM continue it.
Train a new LLM on one series.
Replace the series by a picture.

questions.q: A series has 200 values, each encoded with 4 digits. How many digit tokens (ignore commas)?

options: Small layers around a frozen LLM (patch reprogramming and an output head).

questions.q: What did Tan et al. (NeurIPS 2024) find?
options: Replacing the LLM by simple components often did not hurt accuracy.

questions.q: Which agent rules are good practice? Select all.
options: Numbers in the final answer come from tool output.
A fixed backtest rule decides the model.
Data text is passed to the prompt unfiltered.

questions.q: The agent proposes model X with MASE 0.97, baseline seasonal naive MASE 1.00. The rule is 'must beat baseline by 5%'. What happens?
why: The rule decides, not the LLM.

questions.q: Your manager asks the agent to explain why sales fell. The agent answers with a confident story that has no support in the data. What do you do?
options: Require explanations to cite tool outputs, and mark unsupported claims as hypotheses.
